quest.title: Stones, Coconuts, and Saurian Traffickers
quest.description: In a remote location near the Flower-Feather Clan's borders, a traveling merchant and his Saurian companion have encountered a mysterious problem...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

chapter.title: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

dialogues.text: What do we do...
My friend, please, just say something. Even a growl would be fine — I just need to know what's happened to you.

dialogues.speaker: Debilitated Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: ...Hrrooh?
...Nope, don't get you at all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Even if it were {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, such a simple statement alone wouldn't be enough to get anything across to us right away.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Ehrrr?

choices.text: ...So uh, what kind of trouble are you in, exactly?

response.text: Ah, passing adventurers. We're saved!
Thank you so much, kind souls! Here's the situation in a nutshell...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: I'm Qax, a traveling merchant. I was out fetching water today when I got separated from my Saurian, King Coconut.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: When I got back, my dear Saurian had been hurt somehow, and had fallen down on the side of the road, unable to walk...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: I thought maybe he'd set off a hunter's trap, but closer inspection didn't reveal any wounds on his leg or blood spatter on his body... Could it have been blunt trauma?

response.speaker: "King Coconut"
response.text: Rroooh! Hroo! Rrooooh!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Seems like your Saurian buddy's in great pain. Neither {NICKNAME} nor Paimon's a sauro-vet, though...

choices.text: Should I carry King Coconut back?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you could certainly do it, given your strength.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But this place is kinda out of the way. If we carry him for too long and open up some unseen wounds while we're at it, we'd just make things worse...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Oh, I wouldn't ask you to do that. I know an itinerant sauro-vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who heads out to fixed locations to make medical calls. I'll ask him to come over.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Could you two please help me take care of King Coconut for a while? I'll be back real soon — one night, tops.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, you're pretty considerate, huh? Alright, guess we can just treat this like a camping trip — we'll have a good rest, and treat your Saurian buddy to some tasty grub while we're at it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Eating some of {NICKNAME}'s food should take the edge off a bit.

choices.text: I just so happen to be tired right now, too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, now that we've mentioned camp, we'll need a campsite. King Coconut's injured, so he'll need shelter from the elements. Staying here isn't an option.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll have to slowly shift King Coconut over to some flat ground, erect a tent, get a pot set up, and light a fire...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: That makes sense. You really are pro adventurers, huh?

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: I'm good at woodwork, so let's split up and gather the required materials — just some common <color=#00E1FFFF>Flammabomb Wood</color> or <color=#00E1FFFF>Ashen Aratiku Wood</color> plus a little cloth oughta do it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Would you mind keeping King Coconut company in the meantime, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You carefully shift King Coconut over to a suitable area and start to build a camp...

choices.text: I just so happen to be starving right now, too...
Should we track down a sauro-vet to help out?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure, but we aren't exactly familiar with any vets...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If we were to show up in front of a sauro-vet we don't know and ask him to come out to this remote spot, wouldn't we get suspected of being up to no good?

choices.text: Do you need a hand?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's up? Any idea what's going on?

choices.text: They seem to have been attacked.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Attacked by bad guys? From the hill over there?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, do you still remember? We've been around here before... We rescued tons of Saurians and other animals from some poachers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Could it be the same people? And they're trying to steal Saurian companions... Are they seriously looking to resell them?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Never mind that... Anyone hiding behind the scenes and harming the Saurian companions of others is pure scum. We can't just let them go!

choices.text: Yup, they're just the worst sort of people.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then let's get moving now, and scout the area.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If they don't have anyone particularly strong with them, we should just take action and round them up — just like how we've rounded up Treasure Hoarders in the past!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not that we'd be scared even if they've got some capable members. We just can't show them our hand when it comes to our counterattack, or they'll escape!

choices.text: I sure won't be going easy on them.
The attackers were on the hill over there.

dialogues.speaker: Sinister Voice From Above
dialogues.text: #Gah, what crappy luck! Last time, it was that blonde {M#boy}{F#girl} and the white-haired fairy who cost me a big paycheck, releasing all the animals I had on me like that. And just now, that Qucusaurus escaped yet again...

dialogues.speaker: Sly Voice From Above
dialogues.text: *sigh* If nothing else, we've got the boss and his enhanced frangible rounds. They're guaranteed to knock even the strongest Tatankasaurus out without leaving a trace!

dialogues.speaker: Sly Voice From Above
dialogues.text: Once the boss's new rounds are mass-produced, we'll put this one to bed in no time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hear that? It really is those nasty Saurian poachers and animal traffickers from back then. C'mon, let's round 'em all up this time!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wow {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, you sounded a little different just then! Don't worry, we'll get justice for your Blubberbeast friend this time!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Speaking of that, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} — do you think you could sneak up to their camp from below and check out what's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you find anything important of theirs in the camp, destroy it — let's create some chaos!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But if things aren't looking too good, just get out of there and leave things up to us. Always focus on your safety first!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Hrrmm!

talks.objective: Gather materials to build the camp

dialogues.speaker: Qax's Gear
dialogues.text: (Rucksacks and boxes packed with various daily necessities. Looks like Qax is running a small business. Place the materials you've gathered here. You can start building a camp in a moment.)

choices.text: Place Materials
We still need to gather more materials...

talks.objective: Gather materials to build the camp

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great — now we can put up a huge camp tent!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Qax returns after a while, carrying a few logs. He pulls out a pot and some fabric from his bag.\nPaimon has picked up a bunch of branches and is using them to make a fire to cook with...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: #Qax is very dexterous and, with your help, has soon built a hut. Paimon and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} set up a pot, and ignite some kindling...

dialogues.speaker: Qax
dialogues.text: Alright, that's our camp done and dusted. Thanks for all your hard work!

dialogues.speaker: Qax
dialogues.text: It's pretty basic, so not the best accommodation. But please make do for now. I'll repay you all later for sure!

choices.text: You've also done quite a bit.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Then I shan't ramble on. I'll get going and find a vet as soon as possible.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Both so King Coconut can recover faster, but also so as not to keep you waiting!

response.speaker: "King Coconut"
response.text: *whimper*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This traveling merchant's quite the straight shooter, and practical, too... Let's hope he can find a vet soon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Next up, time for us to get camping, cooking, and eating together!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: #You prepare food by the fire with Paimon, and cook up several of your specialty dishes — including a sick meal that's easy on the stomach, made especially for King Coconut.\nAfterwards, everyone enjoys a casual, filling meal together. Paimon and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} feed the debilitated King Coconut.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: #After the meal, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} patiently stays with King Coconut, helping him relax, and his condition improves. \nYou chat with Paimon until midnight, and everyone in the camp falls into a peaceful slumber...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmm~ Paimon slept so well! Guess it was all that hard work yesterday, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Uh-oh, {NICKNAME} — King Coconut's turned into a Qucusaurus!

choices.text: You're still dreaming, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... Gee, that was freaky. For a moment there, Paimon thought that the food we made had some weird ability to change Saurians or something...

response.speaker: Weakened Qucusaur
response.text: Arowr... *cough*... Aoowrr...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Errh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It seems like this Qucusaurus is also in a lot of pain. Perhaps it's also been involved in an accident?

choices.text: It has no obvious wounds.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's two Saurians collapsing near this place two days in a row now... Something's fishy about this for sure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, why don't you think up a way to communicate with them and ask what happened?

choices.text: Perhaps it's taken some blunt trauma, just like King Coconut?
King Coconut is inside the tent.
This is clearly a different Saurian.
You don't have to be so polite.

talks.objective: Find a way to communicate with King Coconut and the other Saurian

dialogues.text: What's up? Any idea what's going on?

choices.text: They seem to have been attacked.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Attacked by bad guys? From the hill over there?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Were those bad guys just trying to hunt wild Saurians? But if it was an accident, we didn't see 'em apologizing to Qax or King Coconut...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Or... are they poachers, waiting to steal other people's Saurian buddies instead?

dialogues.text: It's a real shame that Qucusaurus got away. That quality would fetch top Mora, no doubt about it...

dialogues.speaker: Sly Voice From Above
dialogues.text: It's cool. The boss enhanced the frangible rounds. The new models could knock a Tatankasaurus out cold without even leaving a trace!

dialogues.speaker: Sly Voice From Above
dialogues.text: Once those new rounds have been distributed amongst us, we'll be able to capture whichever Saurians we like. We'll strike it rich sooner or later!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hear that? Those guys seem to wanna resell Saurian companions... Those low-down, no-good poachers!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wow, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, you sounded a little different just then! Looks like those guys have really riled you up, huh?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you find anything important of theirs in the camp, destroy it — let's create some chaos!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But if things aren't looking too good, just get out of there and leave things up to us. Always focus on your safety first!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Hrrmm!

talks.objective: Wait for your Saurian companion to act

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew! Not only did we destroy their base... We also figured out what's going on! Let's get back to King Coconut first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And then we can explain everything that happened to Qax.

talks.objective: Return to the camp where King Coconut is

talks.objective: Return to the camp where King Coconut is

dialogues.speaker: Qax
dialogues.text: Welcome back!

dialogues.speaker: Qax
dialogues.text: I guess you're going to collect some cooking ingredients and get breakfast ready.

choices.text: I picked up a few random fish... Do they count?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did you bring the vet by already? That was super quick!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Ehrrr?

response.speaker: "King Coconut"
response.text: Hrroo, mrroo!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks as though King Coconut's made good progress — he's even able to stand up already. Nice!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, where's that vet?

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: I didn't see any of you when I brought him here, so I took him to treat King Coconut first.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: He assessed that King Coconut was hit by a rock flying at high speed and suffered internal bruising... I can't put two and two together, though. There weren't any loose rocks around the spot where King Coconut collapsed.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Luckily, the vet is experienced in dealing with this kind of injury, so he had a special medicine ready to treat King Coconut's internal bruising and greatly relieve the pain...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Now that King Coconut can walk slowly, we can take him to the vet for more comprehensive treatment.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: We found another Qucusaurus near the camp bearing similar injuries — a lost Saurian companion from the Flower-Feather Clan, apparently.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: After treating it, the vet took it back to the tribe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A "rock flying at high speed"... Would that be those frangible rounds that the Saurian poachers were talking about?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, Paimon's getting peeved now...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You and Paimon tell Qax the whole story...\n

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: So, King Coconut was ambushed by those criminals, leading to those internal injuries... Good thing I came back early, or the consequences would've been too dreadful to contemplate!

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Those scum! I've a mind to give them a punch or two...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: No, that's too few. Let them pay it off in installments: Two thousand punches for every victim who had their Saurian companion kidnapped!

response.speaker: "King Coconut"
response.text: Awrrrh!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, that's true! Had we known, we would've tied a few of them up and brought them over to you and King Coconut. Might do you some good to give them a thorough drubbing and let off a little steam.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Anyway, let's put venting to one side for now...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: So the two of you wiped out this criminal syndicate in the time it takes to make breakfast? That's beyond incredible!

choices.text: They haven't been wiped out completely just yet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right. Their boss took off super quick and has probably made it to another of their bases...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We won't show her a lick of mercy next time!

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: If that's the case, King Coconut and I will warn the Flower-Feather Clan patrol crews to keep vigilant and watch out for this criminal syndicate once we get back there.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: The campsite we built can be kept to serve as a rest area for their patrols, and we can use a bulletin board to warn passersby and help them avoid further ambushes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, having the patrols spend more time in this area would help deter any bad guys. That's a real sensible suggestion, Qax!

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Please hold on a second while I get this bulletin board set up...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Qax takes the remaining wood and effortlessly makes a standard bulletin board, using a spray paint can to create a rather conspicuous image...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Voila! All done!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: "King Coconut"
response.text: Hrrrh~

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #This bulletin board... Huh, is that us and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

choices.text: Excellent likenesses.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Thanks for the compliment. Time is of the essence, so I didn't get too hung up on the details...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: I'll try to draw a more formal poster for you two later, both in commemoration of your efforts in fighting the syndicate, but also to remind all of us what you look like.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In any case, this will be... The first base for the campaign against this syndicate of Saurian traffickers. We can come over and check things out if we find the time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hopefully, this place — no, all of Natlan — will be free of these gangs trafficking stolen Saurians and other animals!

choices.text: Could you make us look cooler?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, don't be so demanding. Paimon thinks this style's real heart-warming!

response.speaker: Qax

choices.text: There are still vestiges of that gang remaining.

dialogues.speaker: Weakened Qucusaur

response.text: Now that King Coconut can walk slowly, we can take him to the vet for more comprehensive treatment.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: We found another Qucusaurus near the camp bearing similar injuries — a lost Saurian companion from the Flower-Feather Clan, apparently.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: After treating it, the vet took it back to the tribe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A "rock flying at high speed"... Would that be those frangible rounds that the Saurian poachers were talking about?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, Paimon's getting peeved now...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You and Paimon tell Qax the whole story, plus its connections to your previous animal rescue...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: So, King Coconut was ambushed by those criminals, leading to those internal injuries... Good thing I came back early, or the consequences would've been too dreadful to contemplate!

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Those scum! I've a mind to give them a punch or two...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: No, that's too few. Let them pay it off in installments: Two thousand punches for every victim who had their Saurian companion kidnapped!

response.speaker: "King Coconut"
response.text: Awrrrh!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, that's true! Had we known, we would've tied a few of them up and brought them over to you and King Coconut. Might do you some good to give them a thorough drubbing and let off a little steam.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Anyway, let's put venting to one side for now...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: So the two of you wiped out this criminal syndicate in the time it takes to make breakfast? That's beyond incredible!

choices.text: We should've rooted them all out this time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right. We might have taken their boss out this time, but there might still be more bad guys waiting to claim the top spot and rebuild in secret...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So we can't let our guard down!

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: If that's the case, King Coconut and I will warn the Flower-Feather Clan patrol crews to keep vigilant and watch out for this criminal syndicate once we get back there.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: The campsite we built can be kept to serve as a rest area for their patrols, and we can use a bulletin board to warn passersby and help them avoid further ambushes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, having the patrols spend more time in this area would help deter any bad guys. That's a real sensible suggestion, Qax!

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Please hold on a second while I get this bulletin board set up...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Qax takes the remaining wood and effortlessly makes a standard bulletin board, using a spray paint can to create a rather conspicuous image...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Voila! All done!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: "King Coconut"
response.text: Hrrrh~

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #This bulletin board... Huh, is that us and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

choices.text: Excellent likenesses.

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: Thanks for the compliment. Time is of the essence, so I didn't get too hung up on the details...

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: I'll try to draw a more formal poster for you two later, both in commemoration of your efforts in fighting the syndicate, but also to remind all of us what you look like.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In any case, this will be... The first base for the campaign against this syndicate of Saurian traffickers. We can come over and check things out if we find the time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hopefully, this place — no, all of Natlan — will be free of these gangs trafficking stolen Saurians and other animals!

choices.text: Could you make us look cooler?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, don't be so demanding. Paimon thinks this style's real heart-warming!

response.speaker: Qax
response.text: I'll try to draw a more formal poster for you two later, both in commemoration of your efforts in fighting the syndicate, but also to remind all of us what you look like.

choices.text: But still, we should be wary of any who might remain.
Actually, we ended up taking care of some old foes.

dialogues.speaker: "King Coconut"
dialogues.text: Hrooo... Aoowrrr!

dialogues.speaker: Weakened Qucusaur
dialogues.text: *cough* *hack*!

dialogues.speaker: "King Coconut"
dialogues.text: Must be careful... Must be careful!

dialogues.speaker: Weakened Qucusaur
dialogues.text: Don't get hit, or it's gonna hurt!

dialogues.speaker: "King Coconut"
dialogues.text: Wrooo...

dialogues.speaker: "King Coconut"
dialogues.text: It hurts... It hurts...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa... That was scary. Great job, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like the camp is a real mess! Let's hit 'em now, and take them all out in one go!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: The cunning Saurian traffickers were on high alert. As soon as they saw someone attacking, they took to their hot air balloon and fled...
